transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well… I’m here because I think people are making it sound like I’m just imagining things, and I’m not trying to cause trouble. But I’ve noticed the hospital people, and some people from the agency, like they’ve been watching our house and even my cleaning routes… checking to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband. I just wanted to talk to someone, if that’s okay.
Have you actually seen these people watching your house or is it more of a feeling you have?

I mean… I have seen people around, yes. Maybe not like standing there with a sign saying they’re watching me, but it’s not just a feeling either. The hospital people and some from the agency, they’ve been around the house and around where I clean, like they’re checking up on me… seeing if I’m taking care of my husband right. I know how that sounds, but I’m not making it up.
Do you think these people are trying to harm you or your husband in any way?

I don’t think they’re trying to hurt us, not exactly. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. It’s more like… they’re watching, checking up on me, seeing if I’m taking proper care of my husband. Around the house, and even near where I clean. That’s what worries me.
Do you think these people are watching you because they believe you've done something wrong?

I don’t know if they think I did something wrong exactly… I hope not. It’s more like they’re checking whether I’m doing things right, you know, with my husband. Like the hospital people and some agency folks watching the house and even where I clean, to see if I’m taking proper care of him. I’m not trying to sound paranoid or anything… that’s just what it seems like to me.
Do you believe that these people watching you are specifically targeting you or is it something more general?

I think it’s more… about me, yes. Not in a dramatic way, I don’t want to make it sound like everyone is after me. But it feels like the hospital people and some agency people are watching our house, and even where I clean, because they’re checking whether I’m taking proper care of my husband. That’s why I’m here, really—because people keep saying maybe I’m imagining it, but I don’t think I am.
Do you believe that there is a particular reason why these people are watching you?

I think the reason is… they want to make sure I’m taking care of my husband the right way. I know people keep acting like maybe I’m imagining it, and I don’t want to sound difficult, but it really feels like the hospital people and some agency folks have been watching our house, and even my cleaning routes, just checking up on me.
Do you think these people watching you are part of a larger plan or organization?

I don’t know if I’d call it a larger plan… that sounds like a lot, and I don’t want to exaggerate. But it does feel organized in some way, like the hospital people and some folks from the agency are watching our house and even my cleaning routes, to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband. That’s why I’m here, because people keep saying maybe I’m imagining it, but… I really don’t think I am.
Do you think these people watching you will ever stop checking on you and your husband?

I hope they will stop, yes. I mean, if they can see I’m taking proper care of my husband, maybe they won’t feel they have to keep watching the house or where I go for cleaning. I don’t want to make a fuss about it, doctor, but that’s what it feels like to me. People keep saying maybe I’m imagining it, but I don’t think so.
Do you believe that the people watching you are doing so for a reason that doesn't make sense to most people?

I guess to other people it might not make sense, and I understand that. I’m not trying to sound strange or cause trouble. But to me it does make sense… I’m here because people keep acting like I’m imagining it, but I really feel the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been watching our house and my cleaning routes to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband. Is that… is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you believed that people are watching you for a short period or has this been going on for a while?

It’s been… a while, I guess. Not just a few days or anything. I’d say about 11 months now, the feeling that people are watching us. I didn’t want to make too much of it, but that’s about how long it’s been.
Do you think it's possible that you might be mistaken about people watching you?

I mean… I suppose anyone can be mistaken about something. I don’t want to sound difficult. But it doesn’t feel like that to me, doctor. I’m here because people keep acting like I’m imagining it, but I know the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been watching our house and my cleaning routes, like they’re checking whether I’m taking proper care of my husband. Does that make sense what I’m saying?
Have your thoughts about being watched changed at all over the past 11 months?

Not really changed, no… I mean, maybe I’ve tried to push it out of my mind at times so I don’t worry people. But the thought itself has stayed pretty much the same — that the hospital people and some people from the agency have been watching our house and even my cleaning routes, like they’re checking whether I’m caring for my husband properly. I know that may sound… a bit much, but that’s still how it feels to me.
Do you think it's possible for you to be wrong about the hospital people and agency folks watching you?

I… I know you’re asking if there’s a chance I could be wrong, and I don’t want to seem unreasonable. But honestly, it doesn’t feel like I’m wrong. I’m here because people keep acting like I’m imagining it, but I know the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been watching our house and my cleaning routes, to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband. I’m not trying to cause trouble by saying that… it’s just what I believe is happening.
Do you think there's any evidence or information that could change your mind about people watching you?

I guess… if someone could really show me, in a way I could trust, that nobody from the hospital or the agency has been watching the house or my cleaning routes, maybe I’d try to take that in. I don’t want to be stubborn.

But it’s hard, because to me it still feels like they’re checking up on whether I’m taking proper care of my husband. So I’m not sure what evidence would change my mind, exactly. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Do you think the reason the hospital people and agency folks are watching you is something that most people would find unusual or hard to understand?

I suppose… yes, most people might think it sounds unusual, or like I’m making too much of it. I understand that. I don’t want to sound paranoid or difficult.

But to me, it makes sense that the hospital people and some agency folks would be watching the house and even my cleaning routes, because they want to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband. That’s what I believe is happening. Is that… the kind of thing you mean?
Do you think it would be possible for you to stop believing that the hospital people and agency folks are watching you?

I… I don’t know. I’d like to say yes, because I know that would probably sound better. But it’s hard to just stop believing something when it feels real to me.

I’m here because people keep acting like I’m imagining it, but I do believe the hospital people and some agency folks have been watching our house and even my cleaning routes, checking whether I’m taking proper care of my husband. I’m not trying to be difficult. I just… I don’t know how I’d make myself stop believing it when it still seems like that’s what’s happening.
Do you have any other thoughts or beliefs that you think might be hard for other people to understand?

I mean… mostly it’s that same thing, I think. I don’t want to add more than is really there or sound like I’m trying to make a big issue.

But I do believe the hospital people and some people from the agency have been watching our house, and even watching my cleaning routes, to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband. I know other people may not understand that, or may think I’m imagining it, but to me it feels like that’s what’s happening.

Is that the kind of thought you mean?
Do you think the hospital people and agency folks watching you are working together in a coordinated way?

I don’t know exactly how coordinated it is… I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is. But yes, it does seem to me like the hospital people and some folks from the agency are connected somehow, or at least aware of the same thing.

I’m here because people keep acting like I’m imagining it, but I do believe they’ve been watching our house and my cleaning routes to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband. I know that may sound like a lot. I’m just trying to answer honestly.
Do you think your belief about being watched would change if you were shown evidence that no one is watching you?

I’d try to look at it, I really would. I don’t want to be unreasonable or make this harder for anyone.

But… I have to be honest, I don’t know if it would change right away. I’m here because people keep acting like I’m imagining it, but I know the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been watching our house and my cleaning routes, checking whether I’m taking proper care of my husband.

So if someone showed me something saying nobody was watching, I might still wonder if it just didn’t show the whole thing. I’m sorry, I know that probably sounds stubborn. That’s just how it feels to me.
Do you think there is a system or a complex plan behind why these people are watching you?

I wouldn’t say it’s some big complicated plan, not exactly… I don’t want to make it sound dramatic.

But it does feel like there’s a reason behind it. I’m here because people keep acting like I’m imagining it, but I do know the hospital people and some agency folks have been watching our house and even my cleaning routes, like they’re checking whether I’m taking proper care of my husband.

I don’t know all the details of how it works, but it doesn’t feel random to me. Does that answer what you’re asking?
